title: Dukkan
tagline: Smart Contract Debuger. A modern, clean version of Scaffold-ETH with NextJS, RainbowKit, Wagmi and Typescript.
description: Debug and refine your smart contracts with a live-updating frontend. Scaffold-ETH 2 is an ideal stack for progressing from rapid prototyping to production-grade dApps. Review transaction data from your local tests to make sure everything is working as expected. With our built-in Block Explorer, you can check the transaction details from your dapp while tinkering with it.
how_its_made: A modern, clean version of Scaffold-ETH with NextJS, RainbowKit, Wagmi and Typescript. Supports Hardhat and Foundry. Dapp development using pre-built components for common web3 use cases. Tailwind and daisyUI to style a dapp and give it a modern and appealing design. Designed to simplify interactions with your deployed smart contracts. These hooks are wrappers around Wagmi, an easy-to-use interface with typescript autocompletions for reading from, writing to, and monitoring events emitted by your smart contracts.
